executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-20 reviewed eight current reports; it finds no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields could relieve pressure, but they will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain crucial.
